svg.aria-label: CI SECURITY. taint-trail. The usual fix for a template inside a run: block is to move the value into env:, which removes the finding from every scanner that looks for templates in scripts and nothing from the job. This follows the value after the move, through env:, with:, step outputs and into the called action, until it dies as an argument, reaches a shell, can spoof $GITHUB_OUTPUT, or becomes opaque. Every verdict is a chain with a file and line at each hop. Modelled on a real finding in coordinated disclosure. 707 tests · one dependency · no network · no key
svg.text: The scanner finds the template. This follows the value after someone moves it.
